overview_description.description: Coasts provides a CLI and containerized runtime for running multiple isolated local development environments on a single machine. The tool defines project configuration in a Coastfile and uses Docker-in-Docker or other runtimes to run full stacks per git worktree. It manages port forwarding, volumes, shared services, secrets, and per-branch assign behavior so parallel environments avoid conflicts. Coasts integrates with AI coding agents and worktree-based harnesses such as Claude Code and Cursor, and can run instances locally or on remote machines via SSH. The project is MIT-licensed, free and open source, and targets teams building and testing complex applications with agentic workflows.
